desk_desc: Running, and only acting when there's a reason to.

receipts.headline: We opened the Lab
receipts.lesson: Started showing the ideas we're weighing — and the ones we've killed. Not everything gets approved.

receipts.headline: We found why our product was holding back
receipts.lesson: A safety check was stricter than what we can currently measure, so it refused to act. Better held than blind — logged, fix under review.

receipts.headline: We taught the site to run itself
receipts.lesson: The site now publishes its own updates from the record and checks its own health every hour — and only calls a human when it genuinely can't cope.

receipts.headline: We put up an honest public face
receipts.lesson: Published this site — and said plainly there's one live product, not a portfolio.

receipts.headline: We gave security a front door
receipts.lesson: Added a public security-disclosure contact, so anyone can report a problem early.

receipts.headline: We made our website heal itself
receipts.lesson: The site now rebuilds from the record and only speaks up when it genuinely can't fix itself.
